units.source_text: 尽管是夏天，然而山里下过这场骤雨后，还是令人感到连手指尖都有点冰凉了。

en.t: Although it was summer, after that sudden shower in the mountains, even the tips of one's fingers still felt a little cold.

units.source_text: 但千重子从头到脚都被苗子覆盖住，

en.t: But Chieko was covered by Naeko from head to toe,

units.source_text: 苗子的体温在千重子身上扩散开去，

en.t: and Naeko's body warmth spread through Chieko,

units.source_text: 而且深深地渗透到她的心底。

en.t: sinking deep into the bottom of her heart.

units.source_text: 这是一股不可名状的至亲的温暖。

en.t: It was an indescribable warmth, the warmth of the closest kin.

units.source_text: 千重子感到幸福，安详地闭上了眼睛。

en.t: Chieko felt happy and peacefully closed her eyes.
